# Compiled card experimental fixtures v1

This directory is inert experimental source and test evidence. Nothing here is imported by the generator, web host, APKG exporter or package entry points. It does not enable a compiled profile in a product build.

## Frozen version and scope

The archived binder is exactly v2b runtime `e559bd68401cb16fb0a2ffaba60aeca11bf76dffc25d0880a9873e1223042dc9`. Host support is exactly `9c890923f0a3a2efde15c18d38a7a3e2ebb8b015e79c051e239f0225aef05898`; active Slim adapter is exactly `c64d0cbd78a767d56fa06b6f1e9fb37ce3a8f35289c5a13b1bc5a679fc41da4e`. Their runtime/adapter bytes are unchanged.

Only **abolish** has completed the isolated full-host path. It has four physical sentence occurrences / eight native-and-SF roots. **Train remains unsupported by that host profile because its two preserved Slim slots are not covered.** Its archived binder fixtures still verify the real three-target merge into one row, three full audit members, Bank labels and unchanged physical occurrence metadata. A binder-only fixture is not full-host acceptance.

The reviewer's sibling/outer-boundary P2 is **not covered/fixed by this v2b archive**. A separate v2c repair is being prepared; it is intentionally not mixed with the inputs that were actually measured. Do not treat this archive as release approval.

The parent separately observed Safari on the frozen v2b small-card QA. These Node fixtures do not repeat browser timings, full authored-script execution, package import or device acceptance.

## Run the portable contracts

From the repository root, with its existing `jsdom` dependency available:

```
node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/fixtures/experimental-compiled-card-v1/*.test.cjs tests/fixtures/experimental-compiled-card-v1/*/*.test.cjs
```

No project installation script, Python module, temporary directory, absolute dependency import or external service is used. Tests produce no generated runtime/frame files. The checked-in raw TAP log is `portable-tests.log`.

The suite consists of 18 active-Slim adapter contracts, 13 binder/rebased-replay contracts, three observer contracts, eight caller contracts and two archive-integrity contracts. The historical real 2 MB native modules are not copied: the old native inverse assertion is replaced by an explicit local active-slice inverse plus sealed full-module evidence pins. This is recorded as a portability edit and is not described as reexecuting that historical full-module proof.

## Preserved inputs

- `runtime.js`: exact v2b binder. `host/host-support.js`, `host/adapt.cjs` and `host/source-frame.js`: exact host experiment source.
- `native/`: exact active Slim original/candidate/v1 reference/adapter/edit records. They retain the original else blocks and reversible boundaries.
- `abolish/` and `train/`: original final HTML, profiles and external anchors. The large train final HTML is stored as deterministic gzip; test readers decode it losslessly. Its decoded SHA remains the frozen original SHA.
- `replay/`: original v2 rebased replay profiles, anchors and derived body inputs, with repeated profile/body bytes stored as deterministic gzip. This changes storage only; decoded source/profile/body SHA values are preserved.
- `authors/`, `original-author-library.js`, `original-residual.js`: the small original author/filter/reader/residual closures used by the contracts.
- `train/group-merge-proof.json`: exact merge proof used by the existing positive contract.
- `host/abolish/`: exact small final body/profile used by the full-host bundle, retained as evidence rather than as an implicit test of the whole host.

Some original train audit/provenance payloads contain source-machine file paths. They remain opaque source evidence to preserve original body/profile hashes; no executable test reads those locations. Removing those strings would create different evidence. Removed absolute test imports/temporary data locations are visible in the portability diff record.

## Evidence and edits

`fixture-seals.json` maps each frozen source to stored and decoded repository SHA/length. Byte-exact code and payloads are distinguished from test-only portability edits. `portability-edits.json` records the actual before/after test diffs: relative dependency/data paths, lossless decompression, an independent Node crypto SHA helper, removal of output writes, a bounded history-ready wait replacing a fixed 15 ms test delay, and the explicitly bounded native-inverse portability substitution. Runtime algorithms are not rewritten.

`external-evidence.json` pins the historical full-author harness, eight-root HTML equality, 26/50 closure/event evidence and full-host bundle. Those large historical oracles are references only. The portable suite does **not** claim that it reran the full eleven-author harness or captured browser evidence again.

The directory did not exist before this archive. No existing untracked fixture was replaced, and no outer README, product module, package file or Git commit was changed by this task.

The first concurrent portable run had one history-readiness test timeout at its original fixed 15 ms delay (43/44). The test now waits for the same original readiness condition with a one-second bound; its assertions and runtime code are unchanged. The initial log is preserved, and the final full run is 44/44.
